scripts.dev:electron: corepack pnpm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-dev.mjs
scripts.dev:shell:clean: pnpm run clean:src-js && pnpm run dev:shell
scripts.prepare:workspace-surfaces: corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/sdk build && corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/kit build
scripts.check:cargo: pnpm run prepare:runtime-bundle && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:cargo:clippy: pnpm run prepare:runtime-bundle && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.check:cargo:test: pnpm run prepare:runtime-bundle && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:cargo:runtime-bridge: pnpm run prepare:runtime-bundle && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && cargo test runtime_bridge --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:electron: pnpm run prepare:workspace-surfaces && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-electron-preload.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run check:version-sync && pnpm run check:cargo
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:version-sync && pnpm run typecheck && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && pnpm run check:cargo
scripts.test:quality: pnpm run i18n:check && pnpm run i18n:audit && pnpm run check:e2e-parity && pnpm run lint
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:unit:i18n && pnpm run test:unit:rest
scripts.test:e2e:electron: corepack pnpm run build:renderer && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node --test test/electron-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:quality && pnpm run test:unit
